_comment: First-party My Nether's Delight compat on the NETHER SOUL seed (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). The soul-sand-valley island is the home for MND's powdery_cane (a growing nether reed — Propelplant). Appended as a top-level variant (the valley look + a powdery-cane patch). v0.2 FIX: placed via its CONFIGURED FEATURE `mynethersdelight:patch_powdery_cane` (not a raw ground block) — the block is an age/lit crop whose default state reads 'growth 0%' and drops only a stick; the feature grows a proper cane that drops `powder_cannon` (the plantable) and, when lit near lava, `bullet_pepper`. Soul_sand is a valid soil (the plantable tag `powdery_cannon_plantable_on` includes #minecraft:soul_speed_blocks). The tree-feature place() path is now try/caught (GenerationJob.placeFeatureSafely), so a modded feature can't break generation. Inert without MND: an unknown configured-feature id is skipped by Lookup.configuredFeature → byte-identical generation. IDS VERIFIED vs MyNethersDelight-1.21.1-1.10.2.jar (2026-07-03). ⚠ IN-GAME VERIFY the feature places a harvestable cane on soul sand.
